name: GDB Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，GDB Holdings Berhad 提出以 RM66.51 million 收购 Bina Tegas Sdn Bhd 51% 股权，并计划通过私下配售、附加股及凭单进行融资，公司亦通过 GDB Development Sdn Bhd 拟以 RM32.72 million 收购三幅位于 Sarawak 的地块，其中一幅地块的收购因卖方未满足先决条件而终止。此外，公司涉及多项重大诉讼。
overview_en: In 2026, GDB Holdings Berhad proposed to acquire 51% equity interest in Bina Tegas Sdn Bhd for RM66.51 million, to be funded via proposed private placement, rights issue with warrants, and proposed diversification. The company also proposed to acquire three parcels of land in Sarawak for RM32.72 million through GDB Development Sdn Bhd, with one parcel acquisition terminated due to the vendor's failure to fulfill conditions precedent.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司提出收购 Bina Tegas 51% 股权、拟收购三幅地块（其中一幅终止），并涉及多项重大诉讼。
segments.note_en: The company proposed to acquire 51% of Bina Tegas, proposed acquisition of three land parcels (one terminated), and was involved in several material litigations.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 509,072 收购 Bina Tegas Sdn Bhd 51% 股权。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of 51% equity interest in Bina Tegas Sdn Bhd for RM66,509,072, together with proposed private placement, rights issue with warrants, diversification, and ESOS.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 因卖方未能满足先决条件，GDB Development Sdn Bhd 向 Sport Pavillion Sdn Bhd 发出终止通知，终止收购 Lot 19102。
actions.text_en: GDB Development Sdn Bhd issued a notice of termination to Sport Pavillion Sdn Bhd to terminate the acquisition of Lot 19102 as the vendor failed to fulfill conditions precedent.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就上述地块收购签订补充协议，将取得土地转让同意的时限从买卖协议日期起九个月修订为两个月。
actions.text_en: Entered into a supplementary agreement to revise the timeframe for obtaining consent for land transfer from nine months to two months from the SPA date.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 GDB Development Sdn Bhd 与三方签订买卖协议，拟以 RM32.72 million 收购三幅位于 Sarawak 的地块，总面积约 21,926 平方米。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary GDB Development Sdn Bhd entered into sale and purchase agreements with three vendors to acquire three parcels of land in Sarawak measuring approximately 21,926 square metres in total for RM32.72 million.
